title: Detail Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Vehicle Detailing Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Detail Service Inspection Checklist covers vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature. The detail service advisor records Vehicle Detailing Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Detail Service Inspection Checklist keeps Vehicle Detailing Service exceptions visible until the detail service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Detail Service Inspection Checklist at detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point. Document vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature identity before Vehicle Detailing Service begins. Compare vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature findings with stated Vehicle Detailing Service criteria; route unresolved Vehicle Detailing Service issues to vehicle appearance quality reviewer.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Vehicle Detailing Service, identify responsible parties, detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point, and the linked vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature source.

fields.label: VIN or vehicle, plate, color, and mileage

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Vehicle Detailing Service facts for vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Vehicle Detailing Service inspection checks
items: Paint, trim, glass, wheel, and exterior baseline
Seat, carpet, headliner, console, and interior baseline
Scratch, chip, stain, odor, damage, and sensitive material
Wash, decontamination, correction, protection, and interior step
Final lighting inspection and customer walkthrough

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Vehicle Detailing Service evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Detail Service Advisor both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Damage could worsen with requested process
blocks.guidance: Pause Vehicle Detailing Service when compatibility, damage, contamination, scope expectation, or final quality concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Vehicle Detailing Service proof and route unresolved vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature scope to detail service advisor.
